# Elsevier template rights and provenance

The active Quarto extension is quarto-journals/elsevier 0.4.5, pinned at
b766702f8a0b625eefa78c23c5137c37ff84a43c. Its integration code is distributed
under the accompanying MIT license, copyright RStudio, PBC.
The author partial is adapted to display ORCID links; the receipt records
the adapted checksums. This is a community extension, not a CEA endorsement.

The unmodified elsarticle.cls identifies itself as version 3.4c
(2025-01-11), copyright Elsevier Ltd 2007–2025. Its header specifies the
LaTeX Project Public License 1.3 or later. The publisher's bibliography
style files retain their embedded copyright and distribution terms.
Project MIT licensing does not relicense these publisher resources.

The historical SBC resources and their separate notice are retained for
reproducing earlier review versions, but are not the active submission format.

Publisher instructions:
https://www.elsevier.com/en-gb/researcher/author/policies-and-guidelines/latex-instructions

LaTeX Project Public License:
https://www.latex-project.org/lppl/
